description: This file contains the server-side logic for displaying and updating a student's theory exam answers within an online examination system. It handles data retrieval from a SQL database, populates UI controls with stored answers, and updates marks based on user input.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ShowAns.aspx page, handling display and update of student answers and marks in the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves and displays student's theory answers based on session data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates the database with new marks, removes student from queue, and navigates to course queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
